query:
SELECT r.id FROM relationship r
            JOIN rel_type rt ON rt.id = r.rel_type_id
            JOIN entity e1 ON e1.id = r.from_entity
            JOIN entity e2 ON e2.id = r.to_entity
            WHERE LOWER(e1.name) = LOWER($1)
              AND LOWER(e2.name) = LOWER($2)
              AND rt.name = $3
            LIMIT 1
